items.title: Why are your iPhone photos so blurry (and how to improve it)
items.summary: Blurry iPhone photos can stem from issues beyond a simple dirty lens. Adjusting specific camera settings can help users sharpen their shots and fix image clarity.
items.blurb: Blurry iPhone photos can come down to more than just a dirty lens. Here's how to expertly sharpen your shots and fine-tune your camera settings.

items.title: The Social Reckoning is flopping at the box office
items.summary: Aaron Sorkin's film The Social Reckoning has underperformed significantly at the box office despite having important messages. According to Variety, the movie brought in just $5.5 million over the weekend against a budget ranging between $30 million and $42 million.
items.blurb: As important as some of the messages in The Social Reckoning are, the movie has been drastically underperforming at the box office. Per Variety, Aaron's Sorkin's follow up to The Social Network only grossed a measly $5.5 million this past weekend against a budget that's somewhere within the $30-42 million range. items.title: Epic reportedly delays its Disney video game so it can be made using more AI
items.summary: Epic has reportedly delayed its upcoming Disney video game in order to incorporate more artificial intelligence into its creation. Developers were instructed to utilize AI tools for both code implementation and asset generation.
items.blurb: Developers were apparently ordered to use AI for both code and asset creation.

items.title: Meta says it's caught up to the frontier with its latest Wonder AI models
items.summary: Meta claims its newest Wonder AI models have caught up to the industry's frontier tier. These models incorporate new capabilities such as active memory and active focus.
items.blurb: The models add "active memory" and "active focus" abilities.

items.title: Norway fined a Microsoft subsidiary $9.6 million for allegedly misusing Grindr user data
items.summary: Norwegian regulators fined Microsoft subsidiary Xandr $9.6 million over allegations of misusing user data from Grindr. The company now has a three-week window to appeal this record penalty.
items.blurb: Xandr has three weeks to appeal the record penalty.

items.title: How to find your Amazon 'About You' page (and how to edit it)
items.summary: Shoppers can locate and edit the Amazon About You page linked to their account. Checking this page reveals specific personal labels Amazon may have assigned, including whether it lists flat buttocks.
items.blurb: See if Amazon thinks you have "flat buttocks."

items.title: What's the difference between alkaline and lithium-ion batteries?
items.summary: Alkaline and lithium-ion batteries are built for very distinct use cases. They differ across several key factors, including lifespan, cost, rechargeability, and routine everyday applications.
items.blurb: Alkaline and lithium-ion batteries serve very different purposes. Here's how they compare on lifespan, cost, rechargeability, and everyday use.

items.title: Meta releases its first frontier model, Muse Wonder
items.summary: Meta has introduced Muse Wonder, its first frontier-level model. While the prior Muse Spark focused on lightweight, low-latency execution, the Wonder models are larger and provide better results on complex tasks like coding.
items.blurb: Where Muse Spark aimed to be a lightweight model that could perform at low latency, the Wonder models are larger and said to be more capable, with higher benchmark scores and better results on complex tasks like coding.

items.title: 2027 Rivian R2 review: The Goldilocks electric SUV
items.summary: A review assesses the 2027 Rivian R2 as an electric SUV with ideal balance. It is characterized as being neither too large, too small, nor too costly, making it just right.
items.blurb: It's not too big, it's not too small and it's not too expensive. It's just right.

items.title: WindBorne wins a hefty US Air Force contract for its balloon data
items.summary: Silicon Valley startup WindBorne has secured a U.S. Air Force contract valued at nearly $50 million. The company combines weather balloons and AI to deliver weather prediction data.
items.blurb: A Silicon Valley startup that uses weather balloons and AI to predict the weather won a U.S. military contract worth almost $50 million.

items.title: Beats is collaborating with Pokémon for a Pikachu-themed Pill speaker
items.summary: Beats has teamed up with Pokémon to release a Pikachu-themed edition of the Pill speaker. The partnership follows an earlier meeting between Pikachu and Apple CEO Tim Cook.
items.blurb: The collab we've all been waiting for ever since Tim Cook met up with Pikachu.

items.title: Meta has some Wonder Full new AI models
items.summary: Meta's revamped Superintelligence Labs division has launched two new AI models, Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full. Following the release of Muse Spark and the Muse AI agent, the company claims these new models can compete with the top systems in the industry.
items.blurb: Meta is making up for lost time in the AI race. After launching Muse Spark, the first model from its revamped Superintelligence Labs division, and buzzy AI agent Muse, it's now launching two new models it claims can go toe-to-toe with the industry's best. The new models, Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full, are available […]

items.title: Elon Musk has donated over $276 million to Republican midterm efforts
items.summary: The New York Times reports that Elon Musk has donated more than $276 million to Republican causes since July, making him the top donor for midterm efforts. Approximately $158 million of that funding was directed toward Senate races as one of the largest political contributions in American history.
items.blurb: Elon Musk has handed out at least $276 million to Republican groups since July, The New York Times reports, making him both the party's top known donor and the biggest established midterm donor. $158 million of that money - one of the largest political donations in American history - has been funneled into the Senate […]

items.title: Here's what typically drains an EV battery the fastest
items.summary: Electric vehicle driving range continues to improve, but drivers still look for ways to maximize distance per charge. Certain vehicle behaviors and conditions are known to deplete an EV battery much faster than usual.
items.blurb: EVs are improving their range all the time, but you're looking to maximize your car's miles, right? Certain things will drain your battery most quickly.

items.title: What happens to Google and Apple accounts when the owner dies?
items.summary: A person's digital footprint remains behind after death alongside their physical estate. This raises questions about how tech companies such as Apple and Google handle and manage that stored user data.
items.blurb: When we die, it's not just physical estates that need to be settled, an entire digital footprint survives us. So what do Apple and Google do with that data?

items.title: Citroën has brought back the iconic 2 CV as an electric concept car
items.summary: Citroën has introduced an electric concept vehicle based on its classic 2 CV model. However, whatever production models are inspired by the vehicle will not be made available in the United States.
items.blurb: Sadly we won't be seeing whatever this car inspires stateside.

items.title: Smart just unveiled a new ultra-compact EV at the Paris Motor Show
items.summary: Smart has revealed a brand-new ultra-compact electric car during the Paris Motor Show. The small vehicle is designed to offer decent mileage performance per battery charge.
items.blurb: A little car with decent mileage per charge.

items.title: Honeyjar offers AI tools to improve PR and comms at every company
items.summary: Honeyjar provides AI-driven tools aimed at improving communications and PR workflows across companies. The offering targets common pain points in a PR industry widely viewed as broken by journalists, founders, and PR specialists.
items.blurb: Journalists, entrepreneurs, and even some public relations professionals will tell you that the PR process is broken. But could AI actually make things better?

items.title: How to improve your Android phone's location accuracy
items.summary: Android users who notice inaccurate positioning on their maps can adjust specific settings on their device. Checking and updating these location-related controls helps optimize overall navigation accuracy.
items.blurb: There are a few settings to check if you're having issues with your map's location accuracy.

items.title: How much RAM does a Raspberry Pi actually need?
items.summary: Raspberry Pi boards offer hobbyists an inexpensive platform to build computing projects. Even so, determining the right amount of memory needed for a project can be challenging.
items.blurb: Raspberry Pi boards have helped hobbyists get computing projects started for very little money down. However, knowing how much memory is needed can be tricky.
